summary: Re-run of the Snooze (max 3 intentos) flow on GlobalUnreadBanner after E1's two fixes. All 6 required scenarios PASS end-to-end on Preview using admin rgonzalez (1 sin leer sembrado): (1) initial banner 1/3 visible; (2) ENTER hides banner and sets ss='1'; (3) SPA nav re-displays 2/3, ENTER hides ss='2'; (4) SPA nav re-displays 3/3 (snooze-hint, NOT locked) — confirming FIX A pre-condition; (5) FIX A: 3rd ENTER HIDES the banner on the current view and writes ss='3'; (6) FIX A anchoring: next SPA nav shows the banner with global-unread-banner-locked-hint, NO snooze-hint, and ENTER is ignored; (7) FIX B: setting ss='1' then page.reload() (full browser reload) preserves ss='1' and the banner re-renders with 'Quedan 2 de 3 (2/3)' — no longer reset to 1/3; (8) ENTER while focus is in input[placeholder*='Buscar'] does NOT snooze and the banner stays visible. Both anomalies from iteration_97.json are now resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: GlobalUnreadBanner.jsx — `lockedSticky` latched via location.pathname effect combined with `snoozeCountRef` is the correct fix: the 3rd ENTER updates state without retriggering the latch (read-by-ref), so the current view still hides. Clean and minimal change. OK.

UnreadMessagesContext.jsx — exposing `loaded` and gating the reset effect on `loaded && !hasUnread` correctly disambiguates 'still loading' from 'backend-confirmed 0'. Reload now preserves sessionStorage. OK.

Pre-existing (out of scope, NOT part of this fix) — React hydration warnings 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> span' fire on every render of Projects/Dashboard tables (visible in console on every navigation). Already flagged in earlier iterations; should be cleaned up by main agent in a separate pass.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-seeded unread message for user_admin_main.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes are validated. Verified events sequence: ss starts None → ENTER #1 → ss='1' (banner hidden) → SPA nav → 2/3 snooze-hint → ENTER #2 → ss='2' hidden → SPA nav → 3/3 snooze-hint (NOT locked) → ENTER #3 → ss='3' HIDDEN (current view) → SPA nav → LOCKED (locked-hint shown, snooze-hint absent), ENTER ignored. Reload test: ss='1' then page.reload() → banner shows '2/3' and ss remains '1'. ENTER inside input[placeholder*='Buscar'] does NOT advance ss nor hide. All assertions in the playwright run passed.
rca of the issue: Previous defects (iteration_97) and their resolution: (a) 3rd ENTER locked immediately — fixed by adding a separate `lockedSticky` state that latches ONLY when location.pathname changes and snoozeCountRef.current >= MAX_SNOOZE, so the 3rd ENTER mutates state without retriggering the latch on the same render; visible derivation no longer hinges on the synchronous snoozeCount>=3 condition. (b) Reload wiped sessionStorage — fixed by introducing `loaded` flag in UnreadMessagesContext (true after first /inbox/me/summary completes) and gating the reset useEffect with `if (loaded && !hasUnread)`. The default unread=0 during initial load no longer triggers the cleanup. Both behaviors verified live on Preview.
